title: And both plays involving a fake death plot line #muchadoaboutnothing ...
transcript: Huge shout out to Jamie Lloyd, who has now directed my least favorite and favorite Shakespeare productions that I've ever seen. I just got out of much ado, and it was. It was a delight. It was everything that I wanted from a much ado production. It is my favorite Shakespeare play, and Jamie Lloyd did not disappoint. Did not disappoint. Loved it so much. I went out and bought more merch after the show. So delightful. سبحان الله おめでとう
